---
title: "Album Recommendations"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Choose an album to find two nearby listening recommendations from this collection.

```{r}
#| results: asis

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)

albums <- fromJSON("albums_data.json")

recommendation_data <- albums |>
  transmute(
    artist,
    album,
    genre,
    cover_file,
    track_count = lengths(tracks),
    avg_duration = vapply(tracks, \(tracklist) mean(tracklist$duration_sec, na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
  ) |>
  mutate(avg_duration = round(avg_duration))

cat('<select id="album-picker" class="album-picker" aria-label="Choose an album">\n')
cat('<option value="">Choose an album...</option>\n')
for (album_index in seq_len(nrow(recommendation_data))) {
  cat(
    '<option value="', album_index, '">',
    recommendation_data$artist[album_index], ' - ',
    recommendation_data$album[album_index],
    '</option>\n',
    sep = ""
  )
}
cat('</select>\n')
cat(
  '<script id="album-data" type="application/json">',
  toJSON(recommendation_data, auto_unbox = TRUE),
  '</script>\n'
)
```

<div id="recommendation-output" class="recommendation-output" aria-live="polite">
  <p class="recommendation-empty">Select an album above to get started.</p>
</div>

```{=html}
<script>
const albumPicker = document.querySelector('#album-picker');
const albumData = JSON.parse(document.querySelector('#album-data').textContent);
const recommendationOutput = document.querySelector('#recommendation-output');

const formatDuration = seconds => `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}m ${seconds % 60}s average`;

function albumCard(album, label) {
  return `
    <article class="recommendation-card">
      <img src="${album.cover_file}" alt="${album.artist} - ${album.album} cover">
      <div class="recommendation-card-body">
        <span class="recommendation-label">${label}</span>
        <h3>${album.album}</h3>
        <p class="recommendation-artist">${album.artist}</p>
        <p class="recommendation-stats">${album.genre} · ${album.track_count} tracks · ${formatDuration(album.avg_duration)}</p>
      </div>
    </article>`;
}

function renderRecommendations(selectedIndex) {
  if (selectedIndex === '') {
    recommendationOutput.innerHTML = '<p class="recommendation-empty">Select an album above to get started.</p>';
    return;
  }

  const selected = albumData[Number(selectedIndex)];
  const candidates = albumData
    .map((album, index) => ({ album, index }))
    .filter(({ album, index }) => index !== Number(selectedIndex) && album.artist !== selected.artist)
    .map(({ album, index }) => {
      const genreScore = album.genre === selected.genre ? 5 : 0;
      const trackScore = Math.max(0, 3 - Math.abs(album.track_count - selected.track_count) / 3);
      const durationScore = Math.max(0, 2 - Math.abs(album.avg_duration - selected.avg_duration) / 45);
      return { album, index, score: genreScore + trackScore + durationScore };
    })
    .sort((left, right) => right.score - left.score)
    .slice(0, 2);

  recommendationOutput.innerHTML = `
    <div class="selected-album">
      <div>
        <span class="recommendation-label">You picked</span>
        <h2>${selected.album}</h2>
        <p>${selected.artist} · ${selected.genre}</p>
      </div>
      <div class="selected-album-facts">
        <strong>${selected.track_count}</strong><span>tracks</span>
        <strong>${formatDuration(selected.avg_duration)}</strong>
      </div>
    </div>
    <h2 class="recommendation-heading">Because you like this, try these</h2>
    <div class="recommendation-grid">
      ${candidates.map(({ album }, index) => albumCard(album, `Recommendation ${index + 1}`)).join('')}
    </div>`;
}

albumPicker.addEventListener('change', event => renderRecommendations(event.target.value));
</script>
```
